summary.text: Chris England (listed by Ballotpedia as Christopher J. England), a Democrat, has represented District 70 in the Alabama House of Representatives since 2006 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: England was born on August 19, 1976, received a B.A. from Howard University in 1999, and received a J.D. from the University of Alabama in 2002.
